fusions.name: Sap Draw
fusions.desc: Sends a barbed tendril that deals 8 damage to an enemy carrying one of your afflictions, uses that affliction up and heals you for 30% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Pod Burst
fusions.desc: Bursts a pod of spores in a cone 4 tiles ahead, dealing 12 damage to everything caught in it and leaving each [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. They are stunned for 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Hostplant Patch
fusions.desc: Raises a short-lived growth where you stand. For 10 seconds it restores 3 health a second to you and any ally inside it.

fusions.name: Green Meal
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, you regain 3 health a second for 5 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
